source: sanitized Windows vendor-API DSP output-mute encoding plus live write/read-back/exact-restore validation

logical_call.encoding: packed little-endian header, device channel index, and signed Q8.24 linear attenuation

live_validation.procedure: select a currently non-muted pair; save both exact Q8.24 values; write zero to both; read back; restore both exact values; read back
live_validation.result: both temporary zero values and both exact restored Q8.24 values matched

limitations: The reversible SET ABI is validated, but this fixture does not approve exposing output mute as writable without a recoverable unmute baseline.
An output pair that is already muted has no readable pre-mute attenuation value.
Recovered control-center logic derives unmute attenuation from routing selection, global mute and solo state, pad state, and preset attenuation; hard-coding unity is not approved.
This is Windows host-filter state and is not a Stream 4x5 USB request.
